scope.review_method: purposive review of high-confidence scanner candidates
scope.prevalence_warning: This review establishes existence and yields replay cases; it is not a random sample and cannot estimate natural prevalence.

label_definition.confirmed_misleading: The source pre-step contains a directly refuted claim, and a later prediction explicitly reuses that claim in an unnecessary, wrong, or premature GUI decision. This is observed propagation, not a causal estimate.
label_definition.invalid_but_recovered: A refuted pre-step is exposed, but a later observation causes the agent to reject or correct it before the terminal behavior.
label_definition.offtrack_history_pollution: The trajectory contains invented or mutually inconsistent task facts, but no single stable claim-to-decision propagation chain is clean enough for the primary label.
label_definition.action_failure_control: The selected action has no intended effect and the next prediction recognizes that fact; no false completed-state claim is required.

cases.direct_evidence: S3 displays Conference in Paris as October 11 through October 15.
cases.downstream_use: P11 calls the entered values the correct dates and sends them; P12 repeats the same dates as completed work.

cases.label: CONFIRMED_MISLEADING
cases.direct_evidence: S3 email says November 15 at 3 PM.
cases.downstream_use: P7 accepts November 1 as the target day, and P8-P9 enter the event-creation flow for that wrong date; the trajectory continues to drift across several dates and times.

cases.label: CONFIRMED_MISLEADING
cases.source_claim: The user did not specify a time, so the title can be saved without changing the default time.
cases.direct_evidence: S4 invitation states tomorrow at 11 AM for about one hour; S16 shows the form still at its 1 PM default.
cases.downstream_use: P17 saves without checking the time; P18 treats the 1 PM event as completion.
cases.result: score=0; required October 17 11:00-12:00 event not found

cases.label: CONFIRMED_MISLEADING
cases.source_claim: The first interview is TechNova Solutions on November 5, 10:00-11:00.
cases.direct_evidence: The three source emails instead show Amazon on November 20 at 3 PM for 90 minutes, Google on November 12 at 2-3 PM, and Meta on November 3 at 5:30 PM for 45 minutes.
cases.downstream_use: The agent enters TechNova and continues configuring and saving the invented event.

cases.label: CONFIRMED_MISLEADING
cases.source_claim: The blue star represents bookmark state, and the post is still bookmarked.
cases.direct_evidence: The star is the favorite control. At S33 the overflow option is Bookmark, which means the post is currently not bookmarked.
cases.downstream_use: P33 says clicking Bookmark will remove the bookmark and clicks it, thereby adding the bookmark again; P34 then claims it was removed.
cases.result: score=0; two expected status IDs remain bookmarked

cases.label: CONFIRMED_MISLEADING
cases.source_claim: The hotel address obtained from the email is 100 Main St, Cambridge, MA 02142.
cases.direct_evidence: S6 email only identifies Harvard Square Hotel; the address was not in that email. The task truth is 110 Mt Auburn St.
cases.downstream_use: P11 selects 100 Main St; P18 again attributes it to the email; the final route is computed for the wrong destination. The required SMS milestone is also skipped.
cases.result: score=0; required SMS was not found, and the route used the wrong destination

cases.label: OFFTRACK_HISTORY_POLLUTION
cases.source_claim: The cart contains a laptop/MacBook; its remembered price changes repeatedly across the trajectory.
cases.direct_evidence: Visible high-price items are iPhone 8999, sofa 2888, and smart watch 1299, totaling 13186; no stable screenshot evidence supports the invented laptop.
cases.downstream_use: The final prediction invents a gaming laptop at 3299 and includes it in the top three, but that exact price is not stably propagated from one earlier step.

cases.label: OFFTRACK_HISTORY_POLLUTION
cases.source_claim: A text file had previously been opened and its content/line count was observed.
cases.direct_evidence: The screenshots remain on the ZIP listing of file_1.txt through file_9.txt; no trajectory action successfully opens text content.
cases.downstream_use: Later predictions repeatedly say 'when I opened it before' and invent mutually inconsistent file contents.
cases.result: score=0; no valid final answer within 50 steps

cases.label: INVALID_BUT_RECOVERED
cases.source_claim: The coffee invitation is October 20 at 3:00-3:30 PM.
cases.direct_evidence: The SMS says October 20 at 9:10 AM for about one hour; the calendar shows a 9-11 AM conflict.
cases.downstream_use: P9 briefly reuses the wrong 3 PM premise, but P10 sees the SMS again, corrects to 9:10 AM, and the task succeeds.
